Question: On a sheet of paper, Isabella draws a circle of radius \(2,\) a circle of radius \(3,\) and all possible lines simultaneously tangent to both circles. Isabella notices that she has drawn exactly \(k \ge 0\) lines. How many different values of \(k\) are possible?
